text:
Predicates:
Japanese(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) ::: x sells more than one million copies.

Premises:
∃x (Japanese(x) ∧ Created(x, legendOfZelda)) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ Top10(x) → ∃y (Japanese(y) ∧ MadeBy(x, y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
